title: tolvi repos list --json output
description: The machine-readable list of repos registered on this machine. The registry is a cache over each repo's .vault-meta.json, so entries are verified when they are read: a repo that moved is reported with status 'stale' rather than dropped. Routing answers are computed by the resolver and returned here, so a consumer never re-derives where a document belongs.

tolvi_version.description: The CLI that produced this output, as `tolvi version` reports it. 'dev' for an unreleased build.

repos.description: Registered repos, sorted by path. Empty when nothing is registered, never null.

path.description: Absolute path of the repo that owns the vault.

workspace.description: Workspace from the repo's .vault-meta.json, as recorded at registration.

repo.description: Repo name within the workspace. Absent for a container vault that serves a whole workspace and names no repo.

product.description: Product group, when the repo declares one.

status.description: 'ok' when a vault with a readable meta is still at path. 'stale' when it is not: the entry is kept so it can be reported and forgotten deliberately, never deleted silently.

vault_path.description: Absolute path of the repo's own vault. Absent for a stale entry, which has no vault to point at.

session_note.description: Absolute path where today's session note belongs, computed by the resolver, which may be a shared root rather than this repo's vault. Absent for a stale entry, and absent when routing refuses to answer.

registered.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the repo was first registered. Re-registering keeps the original.
